behaviour: C1: every dm-pairing-* test execution (each test, repeat, retry, invocation) uses fresh USER_A/B/C keys, so no relay history between them exists; specs keep their exact count assertions (pending DMs not counted; confirm reveals exactly this test's 2 held DMs).
C2: computeTestKeypairs() without options is unchanged (per-file salt); perTest is opt-in and refused for UNSALTED_SPEC_FILES.
C3: no dm-* spec publishes from the test process; dm-historical-recovery's peer sends through his own app page (__fewPublishDm -> publishDirectMessage) while the recipient is offline.
C4: window.__fewPublishDm keeps its name, signature, behaviour and the typeof window / NODE_ENV !== 'production' guard; it is installed app-wide from pages/_app.tsx instead of unreadStore.ts.
non_goals: No product code change beyond moving the dev-only bridge.
No per-test identities for non-pairing specs.
Root cause of the dm-pairing-single-scan-mutual:109 click hang (not reproduced; not relay pollution).
deviations_from_finding: dm-e2e-publish-via-app-refactor: dm-giftwrap-bell already publishes via __fewPublishDm and dm-third-party-inbound no longer exists; only dm-historical-recovery still published from the test process. It needed no narrow exception: 'historical' only requires the messages to be on the relay before the chat mounts, which an offline recipient gives through the real publish path.
